title: What the Young-Driver Loading Is Taken On, Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
The base the young-driver surcharge is taken on follows the party the cover carries and how far the trip has
got. The protection charged on the election for the daily cover is the protection fee charged for the trip less
any protection fee returned against it.

1. Where the election declares one or more additional drivers and cover is already running, the surcharge is
   taken on the whole of the protection charged on the election for the trip, the fees for additional drivers
   included.
2. Where cover has not yet begun, the surcharge is taken on the level's daily amount for the election's covered
   days.
3. Where cover is already running and the election declares no additional driver, the surcharge is taken on the
   protection charged on the election for the daily cover alone.

The level's daily amounts, for the second of those bases:

| The level the election stands on | Daily amount |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 0.00 USD |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 14.00 USD |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 26.00 USD |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 38.00 USD |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 52.00 USD |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 64.00 USD |

## The three bases as a table of combinations

| Additional drivers declared on the election | Has cover begun? | The base |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | Yes | The whole of the protection charged on the election for the trip, the fees for additional drivers included |
| One or more | No | The level's daily amount for the election's covered days |
| None | Yes | The protection charged on the election for the daily cover alone |
| None | No | The level's daily amount for the election's covered days |

## Worked on hypothetical elections

An election on Keyturn Standard Protection carrying 8 days of cover, on which cover has not yet begun, takes a
base of 26.00 USD for each of the 8 days, which is 208.00 USD, whether or not an additional driver is declared.

The same election once cover is running, with no additional driver declared and 208.00 USD of protection fee
charged and nothing returned, takes a base of 208.00 USD.

The same election once cover is running, with one additional driver declared, 208.00 USD of protection fee
charged, 20.00 USD charged for that driver and nothing returned, takes a base of 228.00 USD.
